claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. If N<16 output 0. Else k is the largest integer with 4^k<=N, t=2^k, m0=floor((N-t)/(t+1)), m=m0 if m0 is odd and m=m0-1 otherwise, l=N-t-m-t*m; if m<1 output 0. Bits 1..t define R(W)=W^t+sum_{v<t} x_{v+1}W^v and bits t+1..t+m define Q(Z)=Z^m+sum_{u<m} x_{t+u+1}Z^u over F_2; if R or Q fails the exact irreducibility test of proof.md (X^(2^d)=X mod P, and gcd(P,X^(2^d')-X)=1 for every divisor d' of d=deg P with d'<d) output 0. Otherwise the next t*m bits c_{u,v} (bit number t+m+v*m+u+1) give z=sum c_{u,v}Z^uW^v in the field E=(F_2[Z]/(Q))[W]/(R) with 2^(tm) elements, the last l bits are ignored, and the output is 1 iff z^e=1 for e=sum_{j=0}^{t-1} 2^(m*j). All t+m+l prefix and leftover bits are counted in N; R and Q are input, not advice.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"65323783211583831670874691","numerator":"315323783211583831670874691"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"remainder":{"kind":"explicit","terms":[]}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"65323783211583831670874691","numerator":"315323783211583831670874691"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For the single fixed total language L defined in proof.md Section 1, its evaluator A runs in polynomial time on every input, and L is in NP with witness bound zero and the verifier accepting exactly empty witnesses with A(x)=1. In the full Li-Yang B2 model at entire input length N, there is an integer N_0>=256 such that every integer N>=N_0 satisfies C_B2(L_N)>=(315323783211583831670874691/65323783211583831670874691)N. The eventual lower bound has identically zero subtracted remainder. Proof.md Section 5 derives it from the separately proved all-length bound C_B2(L_N)>=(630647566423167663341749381/130647566423167663341749381)N-R_0(N), where R_0(N)/N tends to zero, by the strictly positive difference between these two coefficients. The intermediate bound uses the structural cutwidth improvement gamma_0=(130647566423167663341749381/1000000000000000000000000000) proved in cutwidth.md Theorem 2, not a claim that the finite path sum itself is below gamma_0. This also proves the declared finite projection with coefficient 315323783211583831670874691/65323783211583831670874691 and exponent 1. No explicit threshold N_0 is claimed. Complete supporting proofs are in proof.md, circuit.md, cutwidth.md, krs.md and certificate.md, with the fresh finite path and local-event computation certify.py.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}

claims: Supporting graph lemma: there is one nonnegative nondecreasing function h on the positive integers with h(D)/D tending to zero such that every cubic multigraph G on D vertices, including loops, parallel edges and disconnected graphs, satisfies cw(G)<=(130647566423167663341749381/1000000000000000000000000000)D+h(D). This is Theorem 2 of cutwidth.md, with its complete proof in Section 11 and quantitative local Gaussian estimates in certificate.md Sections 9 and 10.

experiments.purpose: Certify the unchanged finite path premise Gamma_65 < gamma_base=130647566423167664341749381/1000000000000000000000000000 using 80-node tensor Gauss-Legendre quadrature on [0,3], directed 100-digit Decimal initialization, verified roots and weights, localized Gaussian-moment quadrature errors, triple-outlier tails, two-step completions, exact p_1 and rescaled outward integer contractions. In the same run, verify the exact downward lower sums for the buffered curvature probability, the gain innovation-box inequalities, covariance-coupling constants, and min(A*alpha,p/8,B_star)>10^-18. Check the exact improved graph constant, eventual circuit coefficient and positive slack. The full analytic probability, graph, algebraic, full-B2 and uniformity proofs are supplied separately; no numerical check substitutes for them.
